verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://serpapi.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a SerpApi summary. Doc pages are also served as markdown: search-api.md was probed, and pages such as integrations.md, markdown-output.md, pricing.md and many per-engine .md pages appear throughout the evidence. Together these give an agent both an llms.txt entry point and agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt index's full content and depth (e.g., an llms-full.txt), and independent reports of agents actually consuming these docs.
